text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—The Satsuki Sho.
The first trial toward the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I cannot break through here,
the dream of the Triple Crown will vanish like foam.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "In that case, we simply must resort to other measures. Even if we lose, the ideals we uphold will not crumble."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, I want to take this race... No,
the fact remains that I must take it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"How could a hollow 'Emperor' without a crown
ever win the hearts of the people?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I have full confidence in the ideals I pursue.
And in order to achieve them..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
One cannot be persuasive without standing at the top in both name and deed.
That is precisely why I seek the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf spoke with an intimidating presence
so intense it made the skin prickle, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Well, talking so haughtily like this
is nothing more than big talk for the current me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: After all, I am still far too green... unable to even notice the troubles of my fellow Student Council members.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
More than anything,
I was disappointed you didn't consult me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Do you find me that unreliable?
I've lost a bit of confidence in myself."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She smiled wryly, but she had the wrong idea.
Air Groove and the others hadn't told her anything
just so they wouldn't worry her right before her race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"No, it is fine. I understand.
They were simply being considerate of me."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer.
Even so, I wish you had consulted me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "No—I should be the kind of person who gets consulted."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Being someone others can rely on without hesitation,
even before a critical event.
Is that not what an "Emperor" ought to be?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When asked that, I was at a loss for words.
Considering the dream she's aiming for, perhaps striving
for even greater perfection is indeed the right path, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have not yet reached that realm.
All the more reason why I cannot afford to halt my steps.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I must show them... what it means to be strong, to see me as the powerhouse I am.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Therefore, let this "Satsuki Sho"
serve as my stepping stone to the pinnacle.
